text: {who} arrives eleven minutes late, carrying a laptop and an explanation.
{who} says "as I was saying" before making a point that somebody else made first.
{who} has stayed up all night on a slide deck that nobody asked for.
{who} stops to ask how your week has been, and seems to listen to the answer.
{who} challenges a figure on the slide, and turns out to be right.
clue: {who} challenged a figure, and turned out to be right.

text: {who} asks, some way in, which meeting this is.
clue: {who} asked, some way in, which meeting it was.

text: {who} writes something down whenever a senior name is mentioned, and only then.
clue: {who} wrote things down only when a senior name came up.

text: {who} volunteers for the action that nobody wants, and looks tired doing it.
clue: {who} volunteered for the action that nobody wanted.

text: {who} mentions, in passing, that the delay began in another team.
clue: {who} mentioned that the delay began in another team.

text: {who} says nothing for the whole meeting, and is the first to leave.
{who} asks for the minutes to be corrected, on a point of fact that embarrasses nobody but {who}.
clue: {who} had the minutes corrected, against their own interest.

text: {who} shares a screen to show the figures, and shows everyone a holiday booking instead.
clue: {who} shared the wrong thing on screen.

text: {who} has moved chairs before the start, and it takes you a while to see why.
clue: {who} had moved the chairs before anyone arrived.

text: {who} has brought biscuits for everyone, and knows who cannot have the ones with nuts.
{who} talks for some time before someone points out that the microphone is off.
{who} reopens a decision that was settled last month, and asks who settled it.
clue: {who} reopened a settled decision, and asked who had settled it.

text: {who} asks to see the real figures instead of the slide, and reads all of them.
clue: {who} asked for the real figures, and read them.

text: {who} signs off the plan, then asks what it is a plan for.
{who} overruns the meeting by twenty minutes, then schedules another to cover what was missed.
clue: {who} overran the meeting, and scheduled another to cover it.

text: {who} closes the meeting exactly on time, having left out the item about the delay.
clue: {who} closed the meeting on time, without reaching the delay.

text: {who} stops the meeting to make sure the quietest person in the room has been heard.
{who} reads back last month's minutes, in which several things have changed.
clue: {who} read back last month's minutes, and several things had changed.

text: {who} has noticed you are out of pens, and leaves a box on your desk with no form to fill in.
{who} circulates the minutes of a different meeting, and asks everyone to confirm them.
clue: {who} circulated the minutes of a different meeting.

text: {who} adds a footnote to the slide, in a size that only {who} can read.
clue: {who} added a very small footnote to the slide.

text: {who} reworks the figures during the meeting, and sends the correction to everyone, including the people it embarrasses.
clue: {who} corrected the figures, in front of the people it embarrassed.

text: {who} presents a chart whose axis starts at a different number on each slide, and nobody can say whether that was on purpose.
{who} keeps a tracker that disagrees with the slide, and mentions it when asked.
clue: {who} keeps a tracker that disagrees with the slide.

text: {who} marks a late task as complete, and opens a new one with the same name.
clue: {who} closed a late task, and opened a new one with the same name.

text: {who} cannot find the project on the tracker, and adds it during the meeting.
